notes:
Opportunity: Neptune Workbench building a next-gen IDE + CI integration. Primary ask: embed a low-latency code copilot with tool/function calling that can safely run tests, linters, and capture build logs inside ephemeral sandboxed runners.

-- Background / context:
- Founded 2018, offers cloud IDE + preflight CI. Codebase mostly private repos on GH Enterprise.
- Wants code completions and assistant features inside VS Code plugin and their web IDE. Must stream token-by-token to keep developer UX snappy.
- Team is sensitive about any runtime that touches source; preference is to run Redwood agents inside customer-controlled VPC or on-prem ephemeral runners.

-- Technical requirements (from engineering):
- Tool/function calling for: `run-tests`, `run-linter`, `build`, `capture-logs` with structured outputs (exit code, artifacts meta).
- Sandboxing: run each tool in ephemeral container with strict seccomp / cgroup limits; no outbound network from runner except to artifact store.
- Low-latency target: interactive completions <150ms median for token stream; POC to validate streaming performance from Dedicated tier.
- Model/version pinning: need ability to pin model versions per workspace and fall back to lower-cost variant on load/scale.
- KV/prefix caching not allowed to persist code; need explicit opt-in.

-- Security / compliance notes:
- CISO: "We can only allow code execution if agent runs in our VPC and we hold keys."
- Requires SSO/SAML, SOC2 documentation, audit logs with token-level trace, and KMS/HSM integration for encryption of artifacts.
- Data residency: primary customers in NA/EU; must be able to serve EU repos from EU region.

-- Timeline / activities:
- 2026-01-12: Intro call (AE) -- initial qualification; asked for latency targets and sandbox approach.
- 2026-01-22: Deep-dive with infra (SE present) — demo of streaming and function-calling pattern. (ff_2026-01-22_6721)
- 2026-02-02: Security questionnaire sent; Neptune completed initial answers.
- 2026-02-18: Demo of prototype runner design + cost model; follow-up Qs on HSM integration. (ff_2026-02-18_8342)
- 2026-03-01: Legal requested sample contract clause for code execution liability.
- POC plan: 2-week POC to run against a small repo (10k LOC) doing unit/test runs, linting, and streaming build logs into Neptune UI.

-- POC success criteria:
- Model streaming latency within agreed SLO (~<150ms median token latency).
- Tool calls reliably return structured results (exit code + logs) and artifacts land in Neptune S3 in VPC.
- No sensitive code leaves customer VPC; audit logs show complete trace.
- Cost per test-run below threshold in cost model (target <$0.20 per test for typical small unit test).

-- Sales / next steps (short):
- Deliver sandbox design doc (R: SE) by 2026-03-10.
- Schedule POC kickoff w/ infra and security (owner: AE) for week of 2026-03-22.
- Provide Dedicated pricing scenarios + ROI sheet (drive link above).

- Product: "If streaming is smooth, adoption inside our IDE increases drastically — it's the UX we sell."
